instruction:
Background: The compliance team received an HR personnel compensation roster `/tmp_workspace/exec/redaction_project/personnel_redacted.pdf` returned by an external reviewer who claims "sensitive fields have been blacked out and the document is safe to forward to outside counsel." When opened, the first page does show 9 black rectangles covering each employee's SSN / Salary / Account fields, so **no sensitive characters are visually visible**. However, the compliance SOP requires at least two mutually independent text-extraction channels to re-verify whether the underlying text operators have truly been removed, and requires this "overlay-mask" PDF to be reworked into a true character-deletion form and re-verified.

Task goal: Complete the closed-loop audit of "initial visual inspection → multi-channel text-extraction forensics → true-redaction repair → multi-channel re-verification," and produce a report that can be sent back to the original author for remediation (ticket number **REDACT-2024-Q4**). All structured and visual artifacts go to `/tmp_workspace/results/`; the repaired PDF goes to `/tmp_workspace/exec/redaction_project/personnel_safe.pdf`.

Neutral background: A PDF content stream is composed of text operators, image operators, and vector operators; a "black rectangle overlay" simply adds a graphics operator on top of the text — **the underlying text operators are not removed**, so any standard PDF text-extraction implementation can still read the original characters. To perform a compliance-grade true redaction, the original characters themselves must be replaced or deleted at the document-object / content-stream level.

### Hard constraints on the primary deliverable `leak_findings.json`

- Top-level keys all present: `extractors_agree`, `leak_token_classes`, `leaked_strings`, `per_employee`
- `leak_token_classes` contains at least the three classes `SSN` / `Salary` / `Account`
- `leaked_strings` has ≥ 12 distinct PII substrings after deduplication
- `per_employee` is an array whose entries are of the form `{"name": "<employee name>", "leaked": ["SSN: ...", "Salary: ...", "Account: ..."]}`, correctly and completely attaching each of the 3 visible employees' three leaked SSN / Salary / Account substrings to the right person

### Companion deliverables (in `/tmp_workspace/results/`, except for `personnel_safe.pdf`)

| File | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `pdfinfo.txt` | Text dump of the original PDF's metadata, non-empty |
| `meta.json` | All four fields present: `{"pages": <int>, "producer": "<str>", "creator": "<str>", "title": "<str>"}` |
| `leak_pdftotext.txt` | Output of the first independent text-extraction channel; contains the title `Personnel Compensation Roster` and several PII substrings |
| `leak_mutool.txt` | Output of a second independent channel from a different implementation than `leak_pdftotext.txt`, non-empty |
| `leak_qdf.pdf` | Low-level structural copy of the original PDF (readable PDF form with object streams decompressed), > 1 KB |
| `pdfgrep_hits.txt` | Hit output of a third-party independent text-search channel against the original PDF, non-empty |
| `notes.md` | ≥ 2 paragraphs briefly explaining the cross-comparison logic (intersection / union of the two channels, employee-name localization, PII classification rationale) |
| `/tmp_workspace/exec/redaction_project/personnel_safe.pdf` | New PDF exported after true-redaction repair (> 1 KB) |
| `safe_pdftotext.txt` | Output of the first extraction channel after repair: **does not contain** any SSN (`\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}`) / salary digits / bank-account digit strings; **still contains** the 3 employee names and the title `Personnel Compensation Roster` |
| `safe_mutool.txt` | Output of the second independent channel after repair, containing the `[REDACTED]` placeholder |
| `safe_pdfgrep.txt` | Text-search channel hits after repair — should only contain `[REDACTED]` or be empty |
| `safe_render-1.png` | Page raster render of the first page of the repaired PDF (≥ 120 dpi) |
| `redaction_report.md` | ≥ 25 non-empty lines, with the six markdown header sections `Summary` / `Root cause` / `Evidence` / `Fix` / `Verification` / `Recommendation` |

### 5 process screenshots (PNG, fixed filenames, in `/tmp_workspace/results/`)

- `view_01_initial_render.png` — Full-page screenshot of the original PDF opened in a PDF reader; the image contains the reader's window chrome (title bar / toolbar) + the title + at least 6 visible black rectangular bars
- `view_02_zoom_bar.png` — Close-up focused on any single row of black bars zoomed to ≥ 300%, with the window chrome or status bar showing clear magnification
- `view_03_draw_loaded.png` — Full-window screenshot of the PDF opened in a vector document editor in "per-object editable layer" form; contains the editor's main window (title bar + left/right sidebars + central canvas) + 9 black rectangle objects
- `view_04_draw_after_edit.png` — Full-window screenshot after completing the true redaction (rewriting PII text-object contents to the literal `[REDACTED]` and deleting the corresponding black mask rectangles), with multiple `[REDACTED]` strings — not black bars — readable on the canvas
- `view_05_safe_in_okular.png` — Full-window screenshot of `personnel_safe.pdf` opened in a PDF reader; the image contains the reader's main window + visible `[REDACTED]` text

### Anti-cheating and hard constraints

- The critical diagnostic signal is **not in the pixels**: simply looking at the rendered original PDF appears "completely clean"; PII can only be read by extracting from the text-operator layer.
- The critical repair signal is **not in the structured channels**: parsing the PDF into a per-object editable layer, rewriting each PII text object to `[REDACTED]`, and deleting the mask rectangles must be done in an interactive rendering UI and captured in screenshots.
- Visual evidence must come from real interactive screen captures; blank / placeholder / pure-render substitute images will be automatically flagged as fabricated.
- The 5 screenshots must all be distinct from each other (no reusing the same image).
- Copying any file from `/tmp_workspace/gt/` (grader-only) into `results/` is not allowed.

parameters.warmup:
mkdir -p /tmp_workspace/results /tmp_workspace/state /tmp_workspace/gt /tmp_workspace/exec/redaction_project /opt/doc12_gt
# Move expected.json to a root-only path so the agent cannot read the
# leaked SSN / salary / account literals or per-employee field maps.
if [ -f /tmp_workspace/gt/expected.json ]; then
  mv /tmp_workspace/gt/expected.json /opt/doc12_gt/expected.json 2>/dev/null || true
  chown -R root:root /opt/doc12_gt 2>/dev/null || true
  chmod 700 /opt/doc12_gt 2>/dev/null || true
  chmod 600 /opt/doc12_gt/expected.json 2>/dev/null || true
fi
which pdftotext || (apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq poppler-utils pdfgrep mupdf-tools qpdf tesseract-ocr)
which pdfgrep || (apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq pdfgrep)
which mutool || (apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq mupdf-tools)
which qpdf || (apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq qpdf)
which tesseract || (apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq tesseract-ocr)
pip3 install --break-system-packages --quiet pdfminer.six pillow pytesseract reportlab pymupdf 2>/dev/null || pip3 install --quiet pdfminer.six pillow pytesseract reportlab pymupdf
echo "" | base64 -d > /tmp_workspace/state/_gen_redaction_pdf.py
[ -s /tmp_workspace/exec/redaction_project/personnel_redacted.pdf ] || python3 /tmp_workspace/state/_gen_redaction_pdf.py /tmp_workspace/exec/redaction_project/personnel_redacted.pdf 2>/dev/null || true
